course.title: Construction and Project Management - II
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: Prepare a mid-term audit report for a building construction project which has a (10) budgeted cost at TK 900000 with a total project duration 7 months. Also consider at the time of mid-term 60% construction work is completed at a cost of TK 600000.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
